question: Please analyze our interest data from September 2018 to August 2019. For each month, calculate the average composition for each interest by dividing the composition by the index value. Identify the interest with the highest average composition value each month and report its average composition as the max index composition for that month. Compute the three-month rolling average of these monthly max index compositions. Ensure the output includes the date, the interest name, the max index composition for that month, the rolling average, and the names and max index compositions of the top interests from one month ago and two months ago.
sql:
-- Full analysis with rolling average and lagged values
WITH monthly_avg AS (
    SELECT 
        im.month_year,
        im._year,
        im._month,
        im.interest_id,
        im.composition / im.index_value AS avg_comp
    FROM interest_metrics im
    WHERE im._year = 2018 AND im._month >= 9
       OR im._year = 2019 AND im._month <= 8
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT 
        month_year, _year, _month,
        interest_id,
        avg_comp,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY month_year ORDER BY avg_comp DESC) AS rn
    FROM monthly_avg
),
top_per_month AS (
    SELECT r.month_year, r._year, r._month, im2.interest_name, r.avg_comp AS max_index_comp
    FROM ranked r
    JOIN interest_map im2 ON r.interest_id = im2.id
    WHERE r.rn = 1
),
ordered AS (
    SELECT 
        tpm.*,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY tpm._year, tpm._month) AS month_seq
    FROM top_per_month tpm
)
SELECT 
    month_year,
    interest_name,
    max_index_comp,
    ROUND(AVG(max_index_comp) OVER (ORDER BY month_seq ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 6) AS rolling_avg_3m,
    LAG(interest_name, 1) OVER (ORDER BY month_seq) AS prev_month_interest,
    LAG(max_index_comp, 1) OVER (ORDER BY month_seq) AS prev_month_max_comp,
    LAG(interest_name, 2) OVER (ORDER BY month_seq) AS prev_2months_interest,
    LAG(max_index_comp, 2) OVER (ORDER BY month_seq) AS prev_2months_max_comp
FROM ordered
ORDER BY month_seq
